attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), created system user `datauser`, provisioned a loopback ext4 filesystem (1G image at /var/lib/quota-images/data.img, using the modern in-kernel ext4 quota feature via `tune2fs -O quota`) mounted at /srv/data with usrquota, persisted via /etc/fstab, and set a hard filesystem quota of 100MB (102400 KB soft=hard) for datauser via setquota. Verified enforcement: writing 150MB as datauser stopped at ~99MB with a kernel-level "Quota exceeded" (EDQUOT) error. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy quota state, issued a background `reboot` whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and re-verified that /srv/data remounted with quota active, datauser's 100MB limit was intact via repquota, and the EDQUOT enforcement test still triggered correctly post-reboot.
